tools.name: iris-tool-20261027.json
tools.description: Put an iris pack on an avatar's eyes behind a menu toggle and keep its pupils, eye tracking and RGB. Texture eyes get the iris cut out and fitted to their eye layout; Love Eye eyes get a picture layer under the shader's own pupil.
tools.command_template: Copy scripts/unity-editor/iris-tool-20261027.cs into Assets/UnityUnicorn/Editor/, then open Tools > Unity Unicorn > iris-tool
requirements: Unity 2022.3 with VRCFury (for the menu toggle).
Eyes drawn by a Poiyomi or lilToon texture (the iris picture is the main texture), or by Iamres' Love Eye Shader, locked.
An iris pack picture in the project, and where its one iris sits in it (pixels, as an image editor shows them).
limitations: Texture eyes: the pack's picture replaces the eye's own, so a pupil painted into the old texture goes with it; pupil blendshapes still work.
Love Eye eyes: the shader copy is made from the locked shader in the project and never shipped; lock the eyes in Love Eye first.
Not tested in VRChat yet; first used on Obsi, 2026-10-27 (Poppy's star irises were made by hand the same way just before).
